name: proptech-inquiry-agent
description: An agent that answers and triages property inquiries, built on an MCP server with retrieval over listing data.

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @proptech/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p evals/tsconfig.json
